notes.text: Onyx integration: turn it on in Settings > Integrations, then send a finished export to Onyx with "Upload to Steam with Onyx" in the Build & Export window. Needs an up-to-date Onyx on Windows or Linux; Settings links to the download if it's missing or out of date

Linux: the whole window responds to clicks again. Clicks along the bottom and right edges, including the minimize, maximize and close buttons, no longer go through to the window behind GodotHub (#352)
Linux: the window no longer gets a little bigger every time GodotHub starts (#352)
Linux: the window can be resized again by dragging its edges and corners (#352)
Git sidebar: a commit message you've typed but not committed is kept when you close and reopen the sidebar, for each project, until GodotHub restarts
